blocks.text: JERUSALEM — Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said Saturday an Israeli strike killed two staff members at a clinic in Gaza, with the Israeli army labelling the pair as Hamas “terrorists”. The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) identified the men, who worked as security guards at the clinic, as Hamas artillery cell commander Moaz Yousef Alitsbach and Ahmed Sufyan Muhammad Ali Abu. MSF said it was “devastated” by the killings and denounced “a direct hit” on the organization. “Our premises were clearly marked with MSF logos, and their location had been communicated to and was known by the Israeli military,” it wrote on […]...
